name: Hobo-san no Apron ~Yuzuriha Hoikuen Funtouki~
original_name: 保母さんのエプロン～ゆずりは保育園奮闘記～
source:
Main character in an unemployed freeter. One day he witnesses his female school friend getting hurt at a convenience store. As he delivers girl to the nursery school, he is confused for the staff member. He is invited to work here for real till the girl recovers, and he can not say "no".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名失業的自由工作者。一天，他在便利商店目睹一名女同學受傷。把她送到幼兒園時，他被誤認為園內職員。園方邀請他在少女康復前暫時到這裡工作，他實在開不了口拒絕。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
